room_description: A modern kitchen featuring dark brown lower cabinets, white upper cabinets, a black marble countertop island with a fruit bowl, a stove, a microwave, and a strange burger-themed machine built into the tiled right wall.

key_moments.description: Retrieving the bottom half of a burger bun from inside the microwave.
Taking a cooked meat patty from the frying pan on the stove.
Collecting a plate of shredded lettuce from the counter next to the sink.
Placing the bottom bun onto the red tray on the kitchen island.
Finding a bottle of mustard/sauce inside the upper kitchen cabinet.
Completing the burger assembly by adding the top bun.
The burger-themed machine on the wall automatically opens its compartment.
Retrieving the door key from the opened wall machine.
Unlocking the main kitchen door with the key.

solution_steps: Check the microwave for the bottom bun.
Check the stove pan for the meat patty.
Check the sink area for the lettuce.
Open the upper cabinet to find the sauce bottle.
Go to the red tray on the kitchen island.
Stack the ingredients in the correct order: Bottom Bun, Patty, Lettuce, Sauce, Top Bun (already on tray area).
puzzles.reward: Triggers the wall machine to open

solution_steps: Walk over to the newly opened compartment in the burger-themed wall machine.

final_action: The player uses the key obtained from the burger machine to unlock the main wooden door and escape the kitchen.
